description: Introduction to computer graphics. Principles of raster image generation. Example of a graphics API. Graphics primitives, data structures. Coordinate systems, affine transformations and viewing of graphical objects. Introduction to rendering including shading models and ray tracing. Introduction to modelling including polygon meshes, subdivision, and parametric curves and surfaces, colour.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete all of the following
    • Complete all of:
      • CSC225 - Algorithms and Data Structures I (1.5)
      • SENG265 - Software Development Methods (1.5)
    • Complete 1 of:
      • MATH110 - Matrix Algebra for Engineers (1.5)
      • MATH211 - Matrix Algebra I (1.5)
supplementalNotes: • Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 305, CSC 405.
title: Introduction to Computer Graphics
